card.statement: We consider imaginary Verma modules for quantum affine algebra $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ and define a crystal-like base which we call an imaginary crystal basis using the Kashiwara algebra $\mathcal K_q$ constructed in earlier work of the authors. In particular, we prove the existence of imaginary like bases for a suitable category of reduced imaginary Verma modules for $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$.
card.label: Abstract

paper.title: Imaginary Verma Modules for $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ and Crystal-like bases
